ui.WrapEventsinColorBlocksDesc: When enabled, each event is wrapped in a [block1:]…[block4:] strip (Text widget callout style). When disabled, calendar markdown uses plain text lines.
ui.GroupTimedEventsbyTimeofDay: Group Timed Events by Time of Day
ui.ServerportDefault5050Ifbusythe:
Server port (default: 5050). If that port is in use, the app tries the next free ports.
Restart the app after changing this.
ui.ViewerModeOnlyDesc: Opens the lightweight dashboard viewer instead of the editor when you use the main dashboard link. Ideal for wall tablets and kiosks.
ui.BackupNoticeDesc: This backup only includes Dashboard Studio app settings and enabled device capabilities (MQTT topics). Dashboard designs, themes, uploaded images, and audio files are stored separately and are not included.
ui.BackupSettingsTitle: Backs up app settings and enabled device capabilities
ui.RestoreSettingsTitle: Restores app settings and enabled device capabilities
ui.Whensavingoveranexistingdashbo: When you save over an existing dashboard, the previous file is kept as a timestamped snapshot (hidden from the normal file list). Snapshots are not a full backup: export dashboards if you need copies outside Homey. If you uninstall Dashboard Studio, all user dashboard files on Homey are removed.
ui.Perdashboardoldestsnapshotsare: Per dashboard, the oldest snapshots are removed when this limit is exceeded (1–50).
ui.Keepthelastknownvaluesinmemory: Keeps the last known values in memory so a reload can fill the dashboard right away. Full keeps devices and events. Optimized skips events larger than 16 KB. Devices and variables only keeps devices and variables. Disabled stores nothing.
ui.Showsafriendlydashboardnoticew: Shows a notice on the dashboard when the active data driver goes offline. It hides automatically when the connection returns.
ui.Automaticallyreflectssenttopic: Reflects published MQTT topics back to the dashboard so multiple open screens stay in sync.
ui.RestrictaccesstothedashboardIf: Restrict access to the dashboard. When enabled, open it with ?token=… in the URL.
ui.Setacustomwordorpasswordtosecu: Set a custom word or password to protect the dashboard.
ui.Usedwhentheflowcardshowsdatesa: Used when Calendar and RSS flow cards show dates in Markdown tables.
ui.Firstdayoftheweekforweekandmon: First day of the week for week and month grids. Monday (Europe), Sunday (Americas / Japan), Saturday (Middle East).
ui.Orderoficontokentimelabelandsu: Order of icon token, time label, and summary in Convert iCal JSON to Markdown (week/month cells; day view keeps time in the Time column and icon + summary in Event).
ui.Chooseshowblock1toblock4tintsm: Chooses how [block1:]…[block4:] tints map to rows. By event type follows Load & Filter behaviour (timed, all-day, multi-day, recurring). By calendar source assigns a stable tint per feed (calendarId).
ui.OnebindingperlinecalendarIdspa: One binding per line: calendarId, space, then block 1, 2, 3, or 4. Read calendarId from the Load & Filter iCal payload. Lines starting with # are comments. When you run Convert iCal JSON to Markdown, new sources get the least-used block (ties pick the lowest number). Duplicate IDs are invalid.
ui.Whenenabledweekstyleviewsaddse: When enabled, week-style views add section labels such as Night, Morning, Afternoon, Evening (and All Day). When disabled, events are listed without those headers.
ui.Whendisabledcalendarmarkdownco: When disabled, calendar markdown contains no :ph-…: icon tokens and Icon Bindings are ignored.
ui.Whenenabledeventswithoutamatch: When enabled, events with no Icon Bindings match use the default icon.
ui.UsedwhennokeywordmatchesPhosph: Used when no keyword matches. Phosphor icon name (with ph-). Leave empty to reserve width. Default: ph-calendar.
ui.OnelinepericonfullPhosphorname: One line per icon: full Phosphor name (with ph-), a colon, then comma-separated keywords matched against event titles (case-insensitive). Lines starting with # are comments. Example: ph-cake: birthday, bday, verjaardag. If no keyword matches, Convert iCal JSON to Markdown uses the default icon above, or :ph-spacer: when that field is empty—only for timed events (not all-day) and only when Event Order is Icon / Time / Event.
ui.ClearStateCacheDesc: Clears the in-memory cache of last known values. Forces fresh state updates on next reload.
ui.TopicEchoDesc: Echoes published topic events to connected WebSocket clients for live canvas updates.
ui.servicesCalendarNoticeDesc: Configure formatting rules for the Calendar & RSS Markdown services. These determine how calendar events and RSS feeds are rendered in Text and Markdown widgets.
